summary: The Muramite Dominion is the military empire of the Realm of Discord — a brutal, disciplined, and expansionist civilization forged from conquest. It is the seat of Muramite power, where warlords command armies, warworks forge weapons, and invasions are planned.

events: Muramite clans unified under the first Imperator.
The Dominion Heartlands became the center of Muramite civilization.
Muramite armies invaded Kuua through Discord rifts.
Conquest Hold served as the staging ground for the assault.
The Imperator Citadel became the seat of absolute authority.
Muramite commanders prepared for further planar expansion.
